title_uk: Виявлено запуск балістичної ракети
description: Work continued for a large part of the day today in Kyiv and in the region - in Boryspil, Brovary - after the Russian strike. It was a combined strike: there were a lot of ballistics, cruise missiles, and drones. Unfortunately, ballistics is the most difficult right now. If the percentage of cruise missiles being shot down in this strike is about 90%, the situation with ballistics is much worse. Missiles are needed for the "patriots", this is something that can only provide...

It was a combined strike: there were a lot of ballistics, cruise missiles, and drones. Unfortunately, ballistics is the most difficult right now. If the percentage of cruise missiles being shot down in this strike is about 90%, the situation with ballistics is much worse. Missiles are needed for the "patriots", this is something that can only provide...
description_uk: Значну частину дня сьогодні у Києві і в області – в Борисполі, в Броварах – тривали роботи після російського удару. Комбінований був удар: багато балістики, крилатих ракет, були дрони. На жаль, з балістикою найскладніше зараз. Якщо відсоток збиття крилатих ракет в цьому ударі – близько 90%, то з балістикою ситуація значно гірша. Потрібні ракети для «петріотів», це те, що можуть забезпечити тільки...

description: The liquidation of the consequences of the Russian attack on the capital and cities of the Kyiv region is now underway. More than 600 rescuers of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine and police officers were involved in the work in Kyiv, Brovary and Boryspil. I am grateful to everyone who helps our people. In total, 30 residential buildings, an ordinary school, a children's hospital and a kindergarten were damaged in Kyiv and the region alone. Unfortunately, as of now, 15 people are known to have died in Kyiv...

Вдячний усім, хто допомагає нашим людям. Загалом тільки в Києві та області пошкоджено 30 житлових будинків, звичайну школу, дитячу лікарню і дитячий садок.
